title: Install Atlassian MCP in OpenCode
description:
## Context
Configure OpenCode to use Atlassian Rovo MCP (remote MCP server) so the assistant can work with Jira and Confluence in Atlassian Cloud.

## Skills
- beads-workflow

## Branch
`epic/mcp-atlassian-opencode`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] OpenCode is configured with Atlassian remote MCP endpoint
- [ ] OAuth flow works against Atlassian Cloud
- [ ] Quickstart + troubleshooting documented

## Notes
Remote MCP URL: https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp
Prefer OAuth auto-detection / dynamic registration (no client secret).

title: Add Atlassian MCP server config to opencode.json
description:
## Context
Add an Atlassian MCP remote server entry to OpenCode config so OpenCode can connect to Jira/Confluence via Atlassian Cloud.

## Skills
- beads-workflow

## Branch
`epic/mcp-atlassian-opencode`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` contains `mcp.atlassian` with type=remote and url=https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp
- [ ] Uses OAuth auto-detection (no hardcoded secrets)
- [ ] Config uses a reasonable timeout and is enabled

## Notes
Do not add any tokens or client secrets to git-tracked files.

title: Verify Atlassian OAuth + smoke test Jira/Confluence calls
description:

- [ ] Troubleshooting notes captured for common failures (admin approval, domain allowlist, IP allowlist)
